description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker deepseek-v4-flash recipe for DeepSeek's DeepSeek-V4-Flash (MIT; checkpoint revision 60d8d707) served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: InstantTensor loading, FP8 KV cache with block size 256, MTP speculative decoding with two tokens, deepseek_v4 tokenizer, tool-call and reasoning parsers with thinking on and high reasoning effort by default, 500,000-token context (VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN), four sequences, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults), with DG_JIT_USE_NVRTC=0 and VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1. Tensor parallel 2 across the pair uses vLLM's native multi-node launch, eugr's default no-Ray cluster mode, so upstream's --distributed-executor-backend ray is dropped. Upstream's `--default-chat-template-kwargs.thinking=true` and `.reasoning_effort=high` are passed as one JSON `--default-chat-template-kwargs` value (equivalent). The recipe is cluster-only upstream (the checkpoint does not fit one Spark). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash MTP vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
